visual_review.scope: First-version #148 independent garment generation, reviewed fitting, binding, body variants and wardrobe publication; not production topology or cloth collision acceptance.
observations: Root directly inspected listed images using view_image.
Three independent recognizable garment shapes retain openings and can be fitted to the tested avatars.
Open vest shows the underlying torso in the final generated-body view and independent native UE4 control.
Rigid armor stays on the chest; skinned vest and skirt attachment follow the sampled poses.
Final workbench controls, local preview and explicit existing-version refusal are visible together.
limits: Layered surfaces and local fine holes/thin sheets remain, especially on the skirt; these are prototype generated assets.
The original robot also has holes/nonmanifold areas unrelated to clothing fitting.
Knees visibly penetrate the skirt in the squat pose before cloth collision. This is not accepted as final cloth behavior: #152 owns collision/cloth acceptance and #154 must replay this case.
Only representative rendered views were manually inspected; all twelve combinations have separate actual contract and UI receipts.

checks: Three independently reproduced defects fixed and rerun
Twelve actual Godot cases passed including saved Skin/binds/weights/revision and animation
Atomic publication and same-byte GLB hash/import verified; external URI rejected
Final clockwise normals independently compared to actual UE4/Mixamo source normals
Shared viewport preview identity and garment 512/.5/256 preset independently checked
independent_review.scope: Contract review only; final generated source visual review is separate

limits: Reviewed per-item axis/cage fitting, not general learned clothing fitting.
Cloth partition and auxiliary bone preparation only; solver belongs to #152.
Generated surface layering remains; no claim of production-ready topology.
Skirt still has local thin sheets and fine holes; knee penetration is visible in squat replay before cloth simulation. #152 must validate body collision and #154 must retain this integration case.
Clearance diagnostics are sampled, not exhaustive; open/nonmanifold avatar prevents global no-penetration certification.
private_evidence: Original images, derived masks, failed generations, full vertex partitions, scene outputs and screenshots remain in ignored runtime storage.
